acceptanceCriteria: affected either follows go.work sibling modules (selecting dependents in the root repo for a sibling change supplied explicitly), or names the supported cross-repository route (e.g. breakage) in the frontier detail.
Tests cover a go.work with an outside-root sibling.
body: Found by the 2026-10-20 read-only Beamfall setup review (corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 build 676; evidence under the session scratchpad beamfall-review/). Beamfall core-history's go.work uses ../beamfall-plugin-* siblings; affected reports frontier go:workspace-module-outside-root and cannot follow changes across the workspace. Related V1-0874 (go.work parser unification).
title: affected/golang: go.work `use ../sibling` modules outside the repository root are an unresolved frontier
